Hook registry

Source: R/hooks.R
HookRegistry.Rd

Holds an agent's hooks, finds the ones that match an event, and runs them. Each agent has its own registry in agent$hooks; add hooks with agent$add_hook().

HookRegistry$fire()

Run the matching hooks in the order they were added and return the first non-NULL result. Later hooks don't run.

A failing callback is recorded in last_errors(). For PreToolUse the failure denies the tool call; for other events it is reported and the next hook runs.

Usage

HookRegistry$fire(event, tool_name = NULL, ...)

Arguments

event

A HookEvent.

tool_name

Optional tool name, matched against hook patterns and passed to the callback.

...

Other arguments for the callback.

Returns

The first non-NULL result, or NULL.

HookRegistry$last_errors()

Get the errors raised by hook callbacks since the registry was created or last cleared. Use it to check logging hooks, whose failures don't stop the run.

Usage

HookRegistry$last_errors()

Returns

A list of records with event, tool_name, error and timestamp.
